title: If every ticked customer left the term meanwhile, the move is refused
custom_preconds:
Setup file (for Claude sessions; a tester does not need it)

Preconditions

  • You are signed in as a user with the "Admin" role, working in {Location-A}.
    For example: {Location-A} is Staging Heavy Duty - 9919.
  • You and a second user, {User-B}, are both signed in with the "Admin" role, in two separate browsers.
    For example: {User-B} is ZZAUTOTEST S4 Second Admin.
  • COD is the shop's default for new customers.
  • The shop's own term {Term-A}, due 20 days after the invoice date, is held by exactly one customer, {Customer-A}.
    For example: {Term-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-32 N20, {Customer-A} is ZZAUTOTEST S4-32 Solo.
  • Starting screen: your browser shows the Credit Terms page; {User-B}'s browser shows Edit Customer for {Customer-A}.
  • If any record above is missing, mark this test Blocked: "setup not done".
custom_steps:
1. Click the "⋯" at the right of the {Term-A} row.
  2. Click "Move Customers".
  3. Choose "Net 45" in "Move To".
  4. In {User-B}'s browser, set Credit Terms to Net 60.
  5. In {User-B}'s browser, click Save.
  6. In your browser, click "Move 1 Customer".
custom_expected:
Expected results

  • Step 1: the menu opens.
  • Step 2: a window titled "Move Customers from {Term-A}" opens.
  • Step 3: the button reads "Move 1 Customer".
  • Step 4: the dropdown shows Net 60.
  • Step 5: {Customer-A} is saved on Net 60.
  • Step 6: the app's error alert shows "Pick at least one customer to move." and the window stays open.

Exact quotes from the source (for reproducibility)

From: PRD "Credit terms", Confluence 963346440, version 3 (22 Oct 2026, "Renamed to Credit terms", Chris Ward), read 23 Oct 2026 · Epic SV-11638, story SV-11673 (Story 4, Move Customers)

  • Story 4, Error Handling: “If every ticked customer has left the term before the confirm, the move is refused and the app's standard error alert shows "Pick at least one customer to move." The window stays open.”
  • User Feedback Summary: “Move with no ticked customer still on the term (server) | "Pick at least one customer to move." | Standard error alert, window stays open”
